descriptions.subject: clay-lined catch well
descriptions.text:
You see a clay-lined catch well.
A split in the fired lining lets the drawn water drain through the rim. Pack the gap with fire clay.
Repair: 2 fire clay. Composition: Masonry.

A shallow catch well beside the growing beds. Its fired-clay lining forms a basin beneath a broad stone rim.
